message.content: Let me check the git log for the specific fix related to this vulnerability. The regression range was 202311280626:202311290630. Let me check commits around that date:

content:
3b93bdb Merge pull request #373 from dgarske/test_pubfile
fef107f Merge pull request #375 from embhorn/zd17036
bc7ae0a Fixed issue with QoS2 on received publish ACK getting skipped if write is already locked.
4bdde13 Close socket on error in NetCOnnect
8a0cafe Add packet_id to the publish log message in examples.
0336347 Improve logic for detection of active read or write. Add test case for trying to send multiple publishes in the same thread.
6fdcee6 Add back logic to return MQTT_CODE_CONTINUE if a write lock happens while data has partially been written.
072f5b8 By default keep mutex locked if we tried to write. The wolfSSL TLS engine requires an SSL_Write that returns WANT_WRITE to be called with the same buffer/sz, not a different one, even if no data was sent. If user wants to enable the feature anyways they can use `WOLFMQTT_ALLOW_NODATA_UNLOCK`. Only the write that has this logic as the issue doesn't exist for an SSL_Read.
